detail.longDescription: minimi is personal intelligence that comes to you. We are building a world where before you've said a word, AI already understands you and frees you from the work of managing your own life, so you can spend that time actually living it. Right now, you can adopt AI cats 🐱 on minimi: 1. Cotton captures your personal context so you never explain yourself to AI again. 2. Melody uses this personal context and never lets you miss your commitments More cats 🐈 🐈‍⬛ to come soon...
